units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 13</cite> (play on <he>אעידך</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">ib.</cite>; cmp. <cite ref="P00133"><he>עֲדִי</he> II</cite>) <he>כמה ק׳ קשטתי אתכם</he> with how many ornaments did I adorn you!; Pesik. Naḥ., p. 124ᵇ.
<cite ref="Ketubot 71b:8">Keth. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>נהנית מריח קִשּׁוּטֶיהָ וכ׳</he> is benefited by the perfume of her toilet for thirty days (can be thirty days without perfumery).

<cite ref="Ketubot 71b:3">Ib.</cite> (in Chald. diction) <he>דתלנהו לקשוטיה וכ׳</he> (read: <he>דתלתנהו</he>) when she attached her vow of abstinence from perfuming herself to marital intercourse &c.; a. e.
